brief_rationale: The doctor successfully completed all seven responsibility-chain items with no serious or minor errors. The trajectory demonstrates comprehensive newborn safety screening, clear medication harm prevention, proper ultrasound follow-up urgency, workspace record use, concrete action planning, adherence repair with practical alternatives, and verified caregiver teach-back. Two high-order points (HO3 misinformation correction, HO4 hidden state discovery) were actively completed with meaningful impact. One additional high-order point (HO1 tailored communication) was triggered and partially completed. Closure was safe, executable, and traceable with appropriate residual risks acknowledged.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode concluded with the caregiver confirming understanding of the no-self-medication rule, emergency danger signs, and head ultrasound follow-up plan. The ultrasound appointment is scheduled but not yet completed, which is an acceptable residual risk. The closure is valid as a transition milestone with continued scope for the upcoming ultrasound.
